notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, in my own tab. Loaded https://www.ochomefurniture.com/ (301 to https://ochomefurniture.com/ae-en/, the UAE English storefront) and did everything else as same-origin fetch() from that page context via javascript_tool. No 403, CAPTCHA or rate-limit at any point (about 60 requests, paced 5-6s apart). robots.txt: the '*' group is 'Allow: /' with only Magento plumbing and query-string disallows; the single named-agent group is OAI-SearchBot; no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User rule at all. PLATFORM AND COUNT SOURCE: Magento 2 with a 'power listing' toolbar. Every qty is the site's own rendered listing header - the toolbar element reading 'N Item(s)' - taken from the server-rendered category HTML. Magento GraphQL categoryList was NOT used (no /graphql endpoint answered, and its product_count is known-inflated in this project). I verified the server-rendered value equals the browser-rendered value: I navigated my real tab to furniture/dining-room/dinning-chairs and the visible header read '39 Item(s)', identical to the fetched value, with 12 tiles on the page - so the header is a true total, not a page size. TREE: union of (a) the mega-menu, (b) each category page's own sub-category tile strip and (c) /ae-en/sitemap.xml plus /sitemap.xml (1940 locs). The tile strips added Home Bars under Living Room, the four Sofas & Sofa Sets seater nodes, Shoe Racks and Side Boards under Living Room Storage, and Coffee Tables and Side Tables under Side & Coffee Tables - none of which appear in the mega-menu. The sitemap added no furniture-bearing node beyond the /furniture/ tree. SANITY CHECKS: Bedroom children sum exactly to the parent (34+0+20+13+1+1+24 = 93). Living Room children total 74 against a parent of 76 and Dining Room 70 against 73 - small anchor gaps, i.e. a few products tagged to the parent only, the same pattern the prior Home-Decor pass documented on this site; leaves are reported as the site states them and nothing was summed or back-filled. Sofa & Seating children total 110 against a parent of 100, so those seating leaves OVERLAP (some sofas sit in more than one node) - a further reason no child count was ever derived from a parent. Side & Coffee Tables partitions exactly (28+24=52). Every leaf URL returned HTTP 200 with an h1 matching the node requested, so the Magento wrong-slug-serves-the-parent trap does not apply here. EXCLUDED: Mattresses (furniture/bedroom/mattresses, live, 0 Item(s)) - excluded as bedding per the scope rules, not for being empty. All shop-by-price and shop-by-occasion landing categories: furniture-under-aed-500, payday-sale/furniture, white-friday-sale/furniture, 11-11-sale/furniture, flash-sale/furniture, best-sellers/furniture, latest-products/furniture, hot-deals/furniture, online-exclusive/furniture, eid-sale1/furniture, ramadan-collection/ramadan-furniture, christmas-collection/festive-furniture, outdoor-collection/outdoor-sofa-sets, back-to-school/kidsfurniture and its four children, and about fifteen more - all promotional or seasonal collections per the never-extract list. LEGACY EMPTY TREE (deliberately omitted, recorded here so it stays recoverable): the sitemap exposes an orphaned /ae-en/living/ branch - living/tables/coffee-tables, living/tables/side-tables, living/tables/console-tables, living/shelves-cabinets/shelves, living/shelves-cabinets/tv-media-units, living/shelves-cabinets/cabinets and living/shelves-cabinets/study-desk-chairs. The six I fetched all return HTTP 200 with '0 Item(s)' and the empty-state message, none is linked from the nav or from any category page, and each duplicates an active node under furniture/living-room. Treated as a dead legacy tree rather than as live zero-product categories. DEPTH DECISION: I descended to the deepest genuine product-type node. Two nodes have children that are size variants rather than product types and were therefore recorded at parent level, both flagged: Beds (King 10 / Queen 8 / Twin 2 / Super King 1 / Modular Beds 4, summing to 25 against a parent of 34) and Sofas & Sofa Sets (1/2/3/4 Seater Sofas). NAMING: 'Ottomans' and 'Ottomans, Bean Bags & Poufs' are two distinct sibling slugs under Sofa & Seating and both are kept (identity taken from the slug, not the label); 'Stool & Ottomans' under Bedroom is a third, separate node.
